info.title: SupportNova API
info.description: Complaint intelligence backend for Lumora Home Technologies.

get.description: Active departments + categories with nested subcategories, in one call.

post.description: Upload a PDF/DOCX (or TXT/MD) document. Metadata may come from the form or the document header.

patch.description: Change title / category / expiry, or change status. Setting status=active re-applies versioning.

delete.description: Only drafts can be deleted; approved versions are kept for traceability.

get.description: All versions of one document, newest first.
Search usable (active, effective, not expired) policy chunks. mode = keyword | semantic | hybrid.

post.description: Upload a CSV of 'resolution' or 'escalation' rules. Rows are upserted by rule_id.

get.description: Download all rules as CSV (spreadsheet-friendly) or JSON.

post.description: Run complaint facts through the rule matrix and return the EXPECTED (ground-truth) result.

get.description: Rules whose policy reference is missing, outdated, or points to a section that doesn't exist.
Coverage check: every active subcategory should have keywords and at least one rule.
All other complaints from the same customer (SRS Step 53) that this user may see.
Semantically similar complaints (FAISS search), limited to complaints this user may see.
What the Python rule matrix expects for this complaint (preview of Pipeline 2).
The file itself, for the customer who sent it and the staff handling the complaint.

post.description: Run Pipeline 1 on a complaint (?tone=formal etc.). A failed run is still recorded (status 'failed').

get.description: Full record including the exact request sent and the raw response received.
JSON Schema that every GenAI answer must satisfy.

post.description: Add a NEW prompt version (existing versions are never edited, so old analyses stay traceable).
Switch the active version (e.g. roll back to an earlier prompt).

Run the full pipeline for a complaint and route it: verified -> assigned / escalated,
manual review -> review queue. reuse_analysis=true skips the GenAI call if a valid analysis exists.

get.description: Latest validation per complaint as a comparison table. ?format=csv downloads it.
Complaints waiting for a human decision (SRS Step 57), most urgent first.
Open complaints assigned to the logged-in staff member.
Open complaints whose resolution SLA is 'at_risk' or 'breached' (SRS Step 56).
Scheduled follow-ups not done yet (SRS Step 41).

post.description: Run the GenAI + validation pipeline again (optionally with another tone).
Customer adds information. If we were waiting for them, the complaint moves back to 'in progress'.

get.description: Agent Dashboard (Step 62): the logged-in agent's assigned complaints and their workload.
Administrator Dashboard (Step 63): organisation-wide complaint metrics.
Complaint Analytics (Step 64).

get.description: Trend Detection (Step 65): rising categories/products, recurring issues, repeated failures, escalation spikes.
Generate a report (Step 67). format = json | csv | xlsx | pdf (Step 68).
